method.filtering_summary: Live search at about 7:31 AM EAT on 16 sources (14 answered; LinkedIn was rate-limited and ReliefWeb failed again) pulled 2,694 postings. 1,842 were older than 7 days and 50 were old reposts, 253 senior or excluded titles, 141 not target roles, 195 excluded Kenya and 82 duplicates, leaving 131. Roles already shown in earlier briefings were skipped. Jobgether answered live (500 offers, 209 from the last 7 days, 33 kept), but almost every new engineering offer was limited to one European country or the UK; only Oyster's EMEA Rails role made the list. micro1 answered live (57 pulled, 9 kept) but its 5 new roles were engineering-expert contracts and a DC on-site Forward Deployed Engineer role needing U.S. clearance, so none fit. Wellfound blocks automated page checks; its browser check in Ben's saved search is pending, so no Wellfound roles are on this list yet. Himalayas leads were confirmed through the Himalayas API and, where possible, the employer's own board (Canonical Greenhouse, Pavago Workable).

stories.title: xAI will watermark Grok API text by default from November 7
stories.summary: Output from seven Grok API models, including grok-4.7 and grok-4.6, will carry an invisible statistical watermark with an x-watermark response header, to comply with the EU AI Act.
stories.why: If you build on the Grok API, nothing breaks, but generated text becomes detectable; worth knowing for any LLM product work.

stories.title: OpenAI folds Work features into ChatGPT and merges ChatGPT and Codex limits
stories.summary: OpenAI will test a combined Chat and Work experience with a small group, and ChatGPT and Codex will draw from one shared allowance; Instant chats won't count.
stories.why: Agentic features are moving into the main chat product, which is the kind of tooling AI automation roles now expect you to know.

stories.title: Judge lets NAACP Clean Air Act suit against xAI's Colossus data center proceed
stories.summary: A federal judge denied xAI's motion to dismiss a suit claiming it ran at least 35 combustion turbines at the Colossus site without required permits.
stories.why: Shows the permitting and regulatory risk behind big AI compute build-outs.

stories.title: Hyperbolic raises $30M Series A-1 for its GPU compute marketplace
stories.summary: Hyperbolic, which lets companies rent AI compute across about 30 neoclouds, raised $30M led by Walden Catalyst and has raised $50M to date.
stories.why: AI infrastructure startups keep raising and hiring engineers who can work across APIs and cloud tooling.

stories.title: Minicor, co-founded by a Nigerian engineer, raises $3.8M seed
stories.summary: The San Francisco AI startup raised $3.8M led by IA Ventures with Y Combinator and Paul Graham, to connect AI apps to legacy desktop software without APIs.
stories.why: A YC-backed, African-founded team building AI integrations, close to his automation work and worth watching for hiring.

stories.title: &Truth emerges from stealth with a $70M seed for AI code verification
stories.summary: &Truth, founded in early 2026, raised $70M to prove software correct with mathematical proofs; it named no investors or valuation.
stories.why: Verifying AI-written code is becoming its own market, a signal of where AI engineering jobs are heading.

stories.title: Grey builds its own intra-African payment rails
stories.summary: Grey's CEO Idorenyin Obong said at Moonshot by TechCabal 2026 that the company is building direct payment links between African markets to make transfers more reliable.
stories.why: Cross-border fintech in Africa is building infrastructure, a good fit for his fintech integration background.

stories.title: Safaricom lets customers check Fuliza balances on WhatsApp via Zuri
stories.summary: Customers can ask the Zuri AI chatbot on WhatsApp for their Fuliza and other balances; Safaricom announced it on X on November 1.
stories.why: A local example of an LLM chatbot sitting on top of mobile-money data.

stories.title: Fuliza Ya Pochi brings overdrafts to over one million Pochi merchants
stories.summary: Merchants who have used Pochi La Biashara for more than six months can enrol via the Pochi Mini App or *334#, with limits based on business activity.
stories.why: Credit scoring on transaction data is the same problem space as his Kwara loan pipeline.

stories.title: Safaricom pushes M-Pesa deeper into investing, merchants and AI
stories.summary: CEO Peter Ndegwa set out plans around investments, merchant services and OneApp; M-Pesa had 3.13 million merchants and processed 46.4 billion transactions in the year to March 2026.
stories.why: Safaricom's product push means more fintech engineering work in Nairobi.

stories.title: CBK is assessing about 300 AI applications
stories.summary: The Central Bank of Kenya is assessing around 300 AI applications across departments to improve inflation monitoring and nowcasting, keeping human oversight central.
stories.why: Even the regulator is adopting AI, which widens the market for AI engineers in Kenya.
